L00012: ```bibtex L00013: @misc{jing2024dsbenchfardatascience, L00014: title={DSBench: How Far Are Data Science Agents to Becoming Data Science Experts?}, L00015: author={Liqiang Jing and Zhehui Huang and Xiaoyang Wang and Wenlin Yao and Wenhao Yu and Kaixin Ma and Hongming Zhang and Xinya Du and Dong Yu}, L00016: year={2024}, L00017: eprint={2409.07703}, L00018: archivePrefix={arXiv}, L00019: primaryClass={cs.AI}, L00020: url={https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.07703}, L00021: } L00022: ``` L00023: L00024: ## Overview L00025: DSBench is a benchmark for evaluating data science agents with L00026: realistic data analysis and data modeling tasks collected from L00027: modeloff and kaggle. L00028: Given a *task instruction (may contain image and table)* and L00029: *data files*, a data science agent is tasked with generating L00030: a *solution* that resolves the described task. L00007: # 计算RMSLE
L00008: def rmsle(predicted, actual):
L00009:     sum_log_diff = np.sum((np.log(predicted + 1) - np.log(actual + 1)) ** 2)
L00010:     mean_log_diff = sum_log_diff / len(predicted)
L00011:     return np.sqrt(mean_log_diff)
L00012: 
L00013: parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
L00014: parser.add_argument('--path', type=str, required=True)
L00015: parser.add_argument('--name', type=str, required=True)
L00016: parser.add_argument('--answer_file', type=str, required=True)
L00017: parser.add_argument('--predict_file', type=str, required=True)
L00018: 
L00019: parser.add_argument('--value', type=str, default="count")
L00020: 
L00021: args = parser.parse_args()
L00022: 
L00023: answers = pd.read_csv( args.answer_file)
L00024: predictions = pd.read_csv(args.predict_file)
L00025: 
L00026: performance = rmsle(predictions[args.value], answers[args.value])
L00027: 
L00028: with open(os.path.join(args.path, args.name, "result.txt"), "w") as f:
L00029:     f.write(str(performance))
